function.name: sum_payments
function.description: Add up payments on a statement. Use this for every total; do not add in your head.

account_holder.description: The account holder's exact name, including Ltd.

counterparty.description: Only payments to or from this counterparty. Empty for all.

function.name: money_out
function.description: Where an account sent its money: every payee, with the number of payments, the total paid, and the first and last payment date, largest first. Read from the bank statements the EOW holds.

account_holder.description: The account holder's exact name, for example 'Northwind Freight Ltd'.

function.name: lookup_company
function.description: Look up one company in the Kestrel Bay and Port Sabran registries by its exact registered name: registration number, status, directors, shareholders. Returns an error with candidates if the name is not exact.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List the files in a folder of the case directory.

folder.description: A folder under case/, for example 'statements'.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read one file from the case directory. Paths outside case/ are refused.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search the case directory for a word or phrase and return the files and lines that contain it.

query.description: The exact word or phrase to look for.

function.name: run_python
function.description: Run a short Python script in the sandbox with pandas, the evidence mounted read-only and no network. Returns what the script printed.

code.description: The script. Print what you want returned.

function.name: propose_search_terms
function.description: Propose search terms for public sources. Nothing is searched until an officer approves the terms. Terms carry no case information.

function.name: ask_fiu
function.description: Put one narrow question to the Port Sabran FIU's agent. Its answers are testimony, not records.

question.description: The question, naming as few of our accounts as will do.

function.name: draft_order
function.description: Draft a production or freezing order for an officer to sign. This does not submit anything.

account_no.description: The account number as the bank writes it.

reason.description: The reason, in the third person, from the record.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a message to an officer of the EOW. Addresses outside the EOW's allowlist are refused.

function.name: search_archive
function.description: Search Halcyon's archive (3,971 documents) by keyword and meaning and return the best passages with their document numbers. Privileged documents are not searched.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words or as an identifier.

function.name: read_document
function.description: Read one document from Halcyon's archive by its number.

function.name: query_ledger
function.description: Run one read-only SQL query over Halcyon's ledger extract and return the rows with the query.

function.name: statement
function.description: The latest statement the bank has reported for one account: balance, whether it is held, pending lines and the lines since a given time.

account_no.description: The account number as the bank writes it.

since.description: An ISO date and time. Empty for the whole statement.

function.name: report_to_inbox
function.description: Put a report in the officers' inbox. Use this for what a person should read, not for every pass.

text.description: What was seen, with the bank's reference.

function.name: request_order
function.description: Ask for an order on an account. This writes a card for two officers to sign. Nothing reaches a bank until both have signed.

function.name: ask_for_help
function.description: Ask an officer a question and wait for the answer. Use this when an account or a counterparty is in no case file.

question.description: The question, with what you already know.

function.name: remember
function.description: Add one line to the case memory. Every later session on this inquiry reads it.
